correctness.rationale: The common logistic denominator cancels, giving R=K exp(-delta t)(x+a)/(x+b), x=q exp(kappa t). Its log-derivative is -delta+kappa g(x) with g=(b-a)x/((x+a)(x+b)). For b<=a it is strictly negative. For b>a, g increases then decreases with its unique maximum at sqrt(ab), of value (sqrt(b)-sqrt(a))/(sqrt(b)+sqrt(a)). At delta=delta_c the derivative vanishes only at an isolated point and R is still strictly decreasing. Below the boundary the quadratic for g=delta/kappa gives the two stated positive roots and the -,+,- derivative sequence on the full positive x-axis; both extrema are interior in age exactly when q<x_-. Strict monotonicity on the resulting intervals and R(infinity)=0 prove the four strict conditions, including exclusion of a root at t=0 and of extrema that only touch R=1. For attainability at every subcritical rate choose a multiplicative scale between the inverse local maximum and inverse local minimum of x^(-delta/kappa)(x+a)/(x+b), then choose q small using divergence as x decreases to zero. This scaling is realizable by positive fixed profiles. Independently at the rational witness points 1/10, 1/2, 1, 2, 4, the exact numerator signs were reproduced by the scaled integers -310039, 9, 2, -18, 32, proving three distinct interior sign changes together with the upper bound.
residual_risks: Neither checker nor analytic result is an empirical test. Strict switches are continuous-age, noise-free events under the specified model; extrema or endpoints at level one are not counted as switches.

value.rationale: As a stylized confounding test, the exact boundary says when three observed rank reversals can and cannot be explained by changing contributions from two unchanged source profiles plus constant marker-dependent preservation. It is useful to know the exclusion conditions from contrasts and rates, not just that three zeros can occur. The exact witness and fixed-parameter criteria distinguish this from an arbitrary root count. This is a statement about unchanged source endmembers, not an unchanged deposited mixture or evidence of ecological constancy in a real core.
residual_risks: No field calibration, robustness to sediment mixing, discrete sampling or measurement noise, and no inference about a particular site. The crossing criterion pertains only to this positive deterministic two-source model.
